How chronic stress changes attention, memory and mood, and what helps the brain settle.

Stress that lasts starts to feel like a background hum. Names slip, focus frays, and you can feel flat as well as forgetful. That is because ongoing stress acts on the same brain systems that handle attention, memory and mood, so the three tend to move together. The changes are real, and they tend to ease as the load comes down.
